initial.title: WBP demolition sequence
initial.description: Drag the slider to explore the V39 sequence. Components stay in place; drag left to restore them.

stages.title: Clear indoor cargo
stages.description: Remove indoor cargo before dismantling the equipment.

stages.title: Remove transport equipment
stages.description: Remove the transport tables and associated indoor equipment.

stages.title: Remove raised grating
stages.description: Remove the raised grating platforms while retaining the floor.

stages.title: Remove rails and ladders
stages.description: Remove the suspended room’s handrails, ladders and ancillary components.

stages.title: Remove suspended room enclosure
stages.description: Remove the suspended room’s enclosure panels.

stages.title: Remove suspended slab and supports
stages.description: Remove the suspended room’s slab and local supports; retain the main floor.

stages.title: Remove end canopy A
stages.description: Remove the first end canopy using the V39 component grouping.

stages.title: Remove end canopy B
stages.description: Remove the second end canopy using the V39 component grouping.

stages.title: Bay 1: roof and cladding
stages.description: Remove the roof and cladding in bay 1 to expose the main structure.

stages.title: Bay 2: roof and cladding
stages.description: Remove the roof and cladding in bay 2 to expose the main structure.

stages.title: Bay 3: roof and cladding
stages.description: Remove the roof and cladding in bay 3 to expose the main structure.

stages.title: Bay 4: roof and cladding
stages.description: Remove the roof and cladding in bay 4 to expose the main structure.

stages.title: Bay 5: roof and cladding
stages.description: Remove the roof and cladding in bay 5 to expose the main structure.

stages.title: Bay 1: secondary members
stages.description: Remove the secondary members in bay 1 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 1: main beams and trusses
stages.description: Remove the main beams and trusses in bay 1 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 1: columns
stages.description: Remove the columns in bay 1 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 2: secondary members
stages.description: Remove the secondary members in bay 2 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 2: main beams and trusses
stages.description: Remove the main beams and trusses in bay 2 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 2: columns
stages.description: Remove the columns in bay 2 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 3: secondary members
stages.description: Remove the secondary members in bay 3 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 3: main beams and trusses
stages.description: Remove the main beams and trusses in bay 3 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 3: columns
stages.description: Remove the columns in bay 3 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 4: secondary members
stages.description: Remove the secondary members in bay 4 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 4: main beams and trusses
stages.description: Remove the main beams and trusses in bay 4 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 4: columns
stages.description: Remove the columns in bay 4 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 5: secondary members
stages.description: Remove the secondary members in bay 5 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 5: main beams and trusses
stages.description: Remove the main beams and trusses in bay 5 in sequence.

stages.title: Bay 5: columns
stages.description: Remove the columns in bay 5 in sequence.

stages.title: Protect lift platform 1
stages.description: Install protective enclosure 1. Retain the lift platform, guardrails and controls throughout.

stages.title: Protect lift platform 2
stages.description: Install protective enclosure 2. Retain the lift platform, guardrails and controls throughout.

stages.title: Protect lift platform 3
stages.description: Install protective enclosure 3. Retain the lift platform, guardrails and controls throughout.

stages.title: Protect lift platform 4
stages.description: Install protective enclosure 4. Retain the lift platform, guardrails and controls throughout.

stages.title: Remove T1 canopy roof
stages.description: With all four lift platforms protected, remove the T1 roof.

stages.title: Remove T1 steelwork and columns
stages.description: Remove the T1 steel frame and columns; retain the four protected lift platforms.

stages.title: Final zone 1: roof and cladding
stages.description: Remove the roof and cladding. The final three zones follow the order 1 → 2 → 3.

stages.title: Final zone 1: secondary members
stages.description: Remove the secondary members. The final three zones follow the order 1 → 2 → 3.

stages.title: Final zone 1: main beams and trusses
stages.description: Remove the main beams and trusses. The final three zones follow the order 1 → 2 → 3.

stages.title: Final zone 1: columns
stages.description: Remove the columns in place after the main beams and trusses have been removed.

stages.title: Final zone 2: roof and cladding
stages.description: Remove the roof and cladding. The final three zones follow the order 1 → 2 → 3.

stages.title: Final zone 2: secondary members
stages.description: Remove the secondary members. The final three zones follow the order 1 → 2 → 3.

stages.title: Final zone 2: main beams and trusses
stages.description: Remove the main beams and trusses. The final three zones follow the order 1 → 2 → 3.

stages.title: Final zone 2: columns
stages.description: Remove the columns in place after the main beams and trusses have been removed.

stages.title: Final zone 3: roof and cladding
stages.description: Remove the roof and cladding. The final three zones follow the order 1 → 2 → 3.

stages.title: Final zone 3: secondary members
stages.description: Remove the secondary members. The final three zones follow the order 1 → 2 → 3.

stages.title: Final zone 3: main beams and trusses
stages.description: Remove the main beams and trusses. The final three zones follow the order 1 → 2 → 3.

stages.title: Final zone 3: columns
stages.description: Remove the columns in place after the main beams and trusses have been removed.

stages.title: Remove low walls and finishes
stages.description: Remove the remaining low walls and finishes. Retain the floor, foundations and protected equipment.
